companion_guidance: LPG 240 Life Insurance Risk and Life Reinsurance Management
summary: LPS 230 requires life companies (including friendly societies) to give APRA an annual reinsurance report within three months of financial year end setting out particulars of reinsurance contracts in force, and to obtain APRA's prior written approval before entering into, or modifying arrangements into, a Referable Reinsurance Arrangement (an arrangement with limited risk transfer or significant financing features), which APRA may treat as reinsurance or financing for capital and reporting purposes. Note for the corpus owner: GPS 230 and LPS 230 are reinsurance management standards; they are not industry-specific versions of CPS 230 Operational Risk Management, which applies across industries directly.

clauses.heading: Annual reinsurance report
clauses.text: A life company must give APRA a reinsurance report for each financial year within three months after year end, setting out particulars of each reinsurance contract or group of contracts in force during the year (para 7).
clauses.notification_trigger: Within three months after the end of each financial year.

clauses.heading: Prior APRA approval for Referable Reinsurance Arrangements
clauses.text: A life company may only enter into a proposed Referable Reinsurance Arrangement, or modify an arrangement so it becomes one, with APRA's prior written approval; APRA may approve it as reinsurance or as a financing arrangement (para 10).
